svg.title: Pose Pipeline 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何表示輸入與會交出什麼候選；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

svg.text: 分類、分割與姿態方法可能讀同一張影像，卻把它轉成不同層級的 class、mask 或座標候選。

g.data-semantic-relation: pass observed points to a declared geometric solver
g.data-must-show: Pose Pipeline：依據：top-down/bottom-up topology、ordered keypoints/association、camera/fixture 和 geometry solver contract | candidate output: 可用輸出：per-instance 2D/3D pose/transform 加 uncertainty/fallback；不是單一 heatmap/AP/residual | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: Pose Pipeline output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: Pose Pipeline：依據：top-down/bottom-up topology、ordered keypoints/association、camera/fixture 和 geometry solver contract
